families_note: Heavily covered task FAMILIES (avoid or treat as not new): intent classification (Banking77, CLINC, MASSIVE, SNIPS, SGD); general topic classification (DBpedia, Yahoo, AG News, BBC, arXiv categories in 8 archive groups, medical abstracts, patents CPC); review/tweet sentiment and polarity (Amazon, Yelp 2/5, IMDB, SST-2, Rotten Tomatoes, clothing, TweetEval, airline, DynaSent, financial news/phrasebank, app reviews, poems, MELD); emotion (GoEmotions, dair emotion, EmpatheticDialogues, emo2019, IEMOCAP, MELD, DailyDialog, Claude affect items); toxicity/hate/offensive (Civil Comments, toxic conversations, TweetEval hate/offensive, HateCheck, Social Bias Frames, implicit hate, authored hate/offensive items); spam (SMS, Enron, Deysi); NLI/entailment and paraphrase (MNLI, RTE, QNLI, CB, MRPC, label-NLI, authored NLI); yes/no reading comprehension and negation (BoolQ, CondaQA, PubMedQA, ScoNe, This-is-not-a-dataset, ~300 negation templates); fact verification / claim-evidence (VitaminC, SciFact, health_fact, TabFact, Evidence Inference, TrueTeacher, authored evidence items); legal (LegalBench incl. CUAD, hearsay, abercrombie/trademark, overruling, unfair ToS; LEDGAR; authored contracts/hearsay/trademark); biomedical (PubMed RCT roles, DDI, PubMedQA, medical abstracts, authored clinical triage); logical/multi-step reasoning (ProofWriter, FLD, LogiQA2, MuSR, FOLIO, CLUTRR, SpartQA, procedural pg generators); commonsense MCQ (ARC, CommonsenseQA, COPA, numer_sense); stance/argument/debate (IBM ArgQ, wiki-stance AfD, jagged AfD, RumourEval, Emergent, tweet stance); dialogue acts and discourse relations (pragmeval, silicone); lexical/semantic relations (BLESS etc., SemEval-2010 T8, SciIE); citation intent (SciCite, ACL citation_intent); response judging (PRM800K, HelpSteer2, ifcheck, math derivations); prompt-injection robustness; moral judgment (Moral Stories); political/policy codebooks (CAP, Manifesto, political media messages); routing/tool-selection (JevBench router, pg_routing); and ~510 Mixtral-invented business/marketing/customer text-classification tasks. Also avoid all of tasksource/zero-shot-label-nli and the GLiClass (Jev-side) corpora. arXiv archives already used: q-bio, cond-mat, econ, q-fin, gr-qc, hep-*, math-ph, nucl-*, quant-ph (OHS-1); cs, math, stat, eess, astro-ph (OHS-2), papers up to 2026-09-26.
